description:
Returns written insights about how the reader's reading has been changing: genres they are exploring, authors they return to, their pace, and how their themes are shifting. When none are current, ReadingRate generates them first: it sends the reader's past year of finished books (titles, authors, genres, themes, ratings and dates) to its AI provider, stores the new insights in the reader's account for seven days in place of the earlier ones, and counts the generation against the reader's ReadingRate AI usage. Generating takes several seconds and happens at most once a day.

Use when the reader asks about their reading patterns, trends or trajectory. For numbers such as pace and genres, use get_reading_stats.
name: get_reading_trajectory
